title: Transverse conformal volume expansion forces topological entropy on a compact foliated manifold
author: Marie-Claude Arnaud; Jacques Fejoz
work: Invariant submanifolds of conformal symplectic dynamics
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 11 (2024), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.252
difficulty_reason: Transverse volume growth alone does not give an entropy bound when images of a transversal can return through many plaques. The authors construct a uniform leafwise-distance comparison and a finite product-chart partition, then prove that each dynamical itinerary intersects every terminal plaque at most once. This new geometric control gives a uniform volume bound per itinerary and forces exponentially many itineraries, rather than relying on the smoother Yomdin volume-growth theorem.
